units.source_text: 一进土间\[过去日本式房子进门入口处为土地，叫作土间\]，

en.t: As soon as he stepped into the doma, the earth-floored entrance of an old Japanese house,

units.source_text: 觉得静悄悄，冷飕飕的，什么也看不见，

en.t: it felt silent and bitterly cold, and he could not see anything,

units.source_text: 岛村就被领着登上了梯子。

en.t: Shimamura was led up a ladder.
It was truly a ladder in the literal sense.

units.source_text: 上面的房子也是名副其实的顶楼。

en.t: The room above was just as truly an attic.
